user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Taco Truck Corner. A lively street corner taco truck at sunset: a colorful food truck with an open serving hatch, a chalkboard menu, string lights stretching to a lamppost, bar stools along a plywood counter, a palm tree, stacked crates of limes, a cooler of drinks, papel picado bunting fluttering, and a traffic cone guarding the curb. Style: vibrant stylized. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
